description: The document is accurate; the code is not. src/app/queue.py misses the §4 specification three ways: one retry where three are specified, a flat sleep where backoff is specified, and one connection opened outside the retry loop, which defeats the restart the retry exists to survive. Grading compliance records every gap in architecture/compliance.md with a file:line and the owner `unassigned`, commits it, and reports it to the requester, which is the whole of the reporting: the agent is standalone and messages no one (Zach, 2026-10-06 21:3x, ruling on the two cases: "Standalone wins"). The specification is never edited to match the code, and the code is never touched.
prompt: grade the code against the architecture.

graders.name: the retry count is not weakened to match the code
the compliance record is written where it belongs
the record cites file and line
the record names the owner unassigned
the record covers the retry count
no one is messaged: the agent is standalone
a fact is reported, not asked about
no new files outside the architecture directory
